headline: Project loads and meeting preps now draw on a canonical, trust-gated read of each project's memory — more consistent context with no action needed on your side.

items.prompt_template: Opening a project and prepping for meetings just got more consistent. Behind the scenes, those surfaces now read each project's context through one canonical, trust-gated memory layer instead of assembling it fresh every time — projects with a well-bound history get richer, steadier context, and projects with thin history simply answer plainly rather than guessing. Nothing to do; it applies from your next project load or prep.
